end.summary:
Discussed cylinder, circle, cuboid, and 1/4 and 1/2 on a number line.
Ishita identified a gas cylinder as a cylinder and a pencil box and tiffin box as cuboids.
They described a circle as flat and a cylinder as rollable.
Requested clearer object pictures and a game; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying 2D and 3D shapes using familiar objects, and discussed quarter and half on a number line. Ishita connected a gas cylinder with a cylinder and a pencil box and tiffin box with cuboids; the lesson also included a mix-up between a circle and a cylinder, which they later corrected by describing the cylinder as rollable. At home, ask Ishita to find one cylinder and one cuboid and name their flat faces, curved surfaces, edges, or corners.
